title: Evaluation Core Module
summary: Provides the foundational components for defining, configuring, and executing both online and dataset-based evaluations, including LLM-driven dataset generation and integration with agent workflows.

nodes.label: Configure Online Evaluation
nodes.title: OnlineEvalConfig
nodes.description: Defines global settings for online evaluations, including default sinks, sampling rates, error handling, and OpenTelemetry event emission.

nodes.label: Define Base Evaluator
nodes.title: BaseEvaluator
nodes.description: Provides common serialization, specification building, and representation logic for all evaluation classes, ensuring consistent structure.

nodes.label: Implement Custom Evaluator
nodes.title: Evaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for creating specific evaluation logic. Subclasses implement the `evaluate` method to assess task performance.

nodes.label: Structure Evaluation Dataset
nodes.title: Dataset
nodes.description: A Pydantic model that defines the structure of evaluation datasets, including test cases, inputs, expected outputs, and associated evaluators.

nodes.label: Generate Dataset with LLM
nodes.title: generate_dataset
nodes.description: Uses a Large Language Model (LLM) to automatically create structured evaluation datasets based on provided schemas and instructions.

nodes.label: Decorate Function for Online Eval
nodes.title: online.wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that enables online evaluation for a function, capturing its execution, sampling evaluators, and dispatching results asynchronously.

nodes.label: Integrate Online Eval into Agent
nodes.title: OnlineEvaluation
nodes.description: An agent capability that automatically dispatches online evaluators after each agent run, integrating evaluation directly into agent workflows.

nodes.label: Execute & Collect Evaluator Results
nodes.title: _run_and_collect
nodes.description: Internal function that runs a single online evaluator, manages concurrency, emits OpenTelemetry events, and collects evaluation outcomes.

nodes.label: Batch Submit Results to Sink
nodes.title: _submit_group_to_sink
nodes.description: Internal function responsible for batching and submitting evaluation results to configured sinks, handling errors and routing them to appropriate handlers.

nodes.label: Manage Async Event Loop
nodes.title: get_event_loop
nodes.description: Utility function to retrieve the current asyncio event loop or create a new one if no loop is active, ensuring asynchronous operations can proceed.

nodes.label: Execute Single Dataset Case
nodes.title: _run_once
nodes.description: Internal function to execute a single test case within a dataset, capturing its output, duration, and OpenTelemetry spans for detailed analysis.

nodes.label: Execute Single Evaluator (Internal)
nodes.title: online._run
nodes.description: An internal asynchronous function used to execute a single evaluator within the online evaluation framework, collecting its results.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework
nodes.description: Provides the core agent functionality, including the `Agent` class and `AbstractCapability` for building intelligent systems.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: Model Abstraction
nodes.description: Offers an abstract interface for interacting with various Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling model-agnostic operations.

nodes.label: Evaluation Sink
nodes.title: Evaluation Sink
nodes.description: Represents external systems or services where evaluation results are stored, analyzed, or reported (e.g., databases, dashboards, telemetry systems).

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.description: An external observability framework used for emitting traces, metrics, and logs related to evaluation events and function executions.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Components
groups.description: Components that users directly interact with to set up and trigger evaluations.

groups.label: Evaluation Core Logic
groups.title: Internal Evaluation Mechanisms
groups.description: Base classes and internal mechanisms for defining, executing, and managing evaluation runs.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Helper Functions
groups.description: General-purpose helper functions used across the evaluation framework.
